modelDecisions: NOVEL 10.5-inch skillet recipes are linked to CO9590 and the four sets whose price-sheet components include CO9590; no other NOVEL pots or INNOVE sizes.

The common Easy Release shrimp recipe specifies the skillet line but no capacity, so it applies to the three skillet sizes and their set with an explicit capacity note; 10-inch recipes remain exclusive to CO9738 and CO9740.
Go recipes show accessory requirements; the old cup/chopper and Max jar do not inherit these recipes.
Mixing Bowls recipe maps to CO4900 only, not older bowl sets.
No recipes assigned to Wok or Precision Cook without an exact match.
